_comments: Remove with leuO -> leuA: leuLABCD is one TU, so any remaining leuO edge makes the whole operon (including leuA) depend on bursty LeuO. leuO is silenced by H-NS and StpA under standard growth conditions (Breddermann and Schnetz 2016, doi:10.3389/fcimb.2016.00106), so the model's baseline expression of these genes likely should not depend on LeuO anyway
